name: Mycelium
description: Née de la contamination, Mycelium tisse un réseau mycorhizien, maîtrise l'élément Spore, vaporise des spores toxiques, esthétique horrifique biologique. Son corps en décomposition libère des nuages de spores toxiques qui consomment la matière organique pour alimenter l'expansion inexorable du Fléau.

subject.archetype: Fungal Contaminator Bio-Mech Hybrid - Mycelium Class

loadout.armor_outfit: Severely dislocated military tactical armor, plates fractured and spread apart asymmetrically, held together by pulsing white mycelium tendrils and bulging fungal roots, necrotic flesh visibly merging with corroded metal, no symmetry in structure, shoulder areas covered with shelf fungus (polypores), tentacle-like branchiae releasing toxic gas, lianes wrapping around limbs
loadout.arsenal: Bloating mutated rifle fused with pulsating fungal biomass, barrel encased in living organic tissue, spore sac magazines replacing standard ammunition, green luminous veins running along weapon, weapon mouth releasing thick toxic spore clouds instead of smoke, corrosive spore projectors capable of infecting and weakening enemy equipment

attitude.behavior: Full combat commitment with arms thrown outward in aggressive stance, body mid-flip between combat states, releasing concentrated shockwave of bio-energy from entire captured body affecting all adjacent positions simultaneously, surrounded by bursting spore clouds, ground erupting with tendrils responding to presence
attitude.emotion: Pure parasitic aggression, unstoppable contamination instinct, biological berserker state fueled by interconnected mycelial network

color_and_light.lighting_setup: Volumetric fog lighting with toxic green bioluminescence, dramatic rim lighting from spore clouds, subsurface scattering on organic fungal elements, cinematic volumetric haze from thick spore concentration
color_and_light.mood: Menacing, oppressive, horrifying, visceral biological contamination

camera.angle: Low angle emphasizing towering fungal masses and subject power, slight dutch angle for dynamic tension

scenography.setting: Biologically devastated battlefield completely consumed by fungal infestation, massive mycelial networks pulsating visibly across all surfaces converting terrain into hostile living organism, both ally and enemy positions attacked by spreading infection, ground itself alive and hostile with fungal tendrils bursting through without warning, shattered tank wrecks being digested by fungal biomass serving as mobile nests
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Thick toxic spore clouds reducing visibility creating oppressive green haze, massive pulsating sacs throughout scene bursting and releasing contamination, green bioluminescent particles floating in air, ground erupting with hostile fungal tendrils, corroded metal surfaces with pulsating growths, atmospheric distortion from concentrated spore density
